description: Source code for MKLDNN convolution prepacking and execution functions within PyTorch, including context creation, convolution out operations, and run methods.

classes.name: ContextConv
classes.description: Structure holding convolution context including packed weights, bias, padding, stride, dilation, groups, and attributes.

methods.name: createConvPrePackOpContext
methods.description: Creates a convolution prepack operation context with given parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Constructs a convolution context with packed weights and parameters.

methods.name: _mkldnn_convolution_out
methods.description: Performs the MKLDNN convolution operation with given tensors and parameters.

methods.name: mkldnn_convolution_out
methods.description: Prepares tensors and calls the internal convolution out function.

methods.name: get_output_sizes
methods.description: Calculates output tensor sizes based on convolution parameters.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes convolution using the context and input tensor, returning the output tensor.

methods.name: run (overloaded)
methods.description: Executes convolution with output buffer provided.

methods.name: conv_run
methods.description: Runs convolution given input tensor and operation context.
